_comment: Sample relevance labels for evaluation/retrieval_eval.py (Section 20). article_id values here are placeholders — this project's article_id is a sha1 hex string (see db/db.py upsert_articles_normalized), not a small integer. Populate relevant_article_ids by running: python3 retrieval.py --ticker NVDA --style SAFE  and copying real article_id values from your populated db/news.db.
